role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 身手矫捷，飘忽不定；出手迅速，无人幸免；阳炎长索，破阵缚敌；爆裂残像，瞬息飞至；烬灵之焰，难捕难防。
hero_summary_en: Swift and elusive, Ember Spirit strikes all nearby enemies in rapid succession, and ties them up with burning chains. Quickly rushing across the battlefield to arrive at one of his exploding remnants, few can avoid, or capture, his flame.

abilities.name: ember_spirit_searing_chains
abilities.description_zh: 灰烬之灵释放出火焰绳索来缠绕附近的敌人，将他们困于原地并每秒造成一定伤害。
abilities.description_en: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
notes_zh: 将随机选取炘周围的单位作为目标。
不能作用于减益免疫或隐身单位。
notes_en: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.

abilities.name: ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist
abilities.description_zh: 灰烬之灵以燎原之火的速度横冲直撞，攻击目标区域内所有敌人，随后返回所在位置。对英雄造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
notes_zh: 在施放技能时作用的目标就已决定。
对目标的攻击每次间隔为%attack_interval%秒。
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。
施放无影拳时间可以使用其他技能和物品。
notes_en: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every %attack_interval% seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.
facet_text_en: When Sleight of Fist connects with %min_enemies_for_double_sleight% or more enemies, the enemy closest to Ember Spirit will be attacked a second time. Damage for the second attack is reduced by %second_attack_damage_penalty%%%.
facet_text_zh: 无影拳击中的敌人超过%min_enemies_for_double_sleight%个时，距离灰烬之灵最近的敌人会再次受到攻击。第二次攻击的伤害减少%second_attack_damage_penalty%%%。

abilities.name: ember_spirit_flame_guard
abilities.description_zh: 灰烬之灵用火焰之环将自己包裹起来，会消耗受到的魔法伤害，使受到的魔法伤害被吸收一定百分比。烈火罩开启后会对灰烬之灵周围的敌人造成每秒伤害。护盾消失后将失去伤害效果。
abilities.description_en: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
notes_zh: 魔法伤害的吸收伤害值计算先于任何伤害减免效果。
伤害在施加后会额外粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
notes_en: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional %linger_duration% seconds after application.

abilities.name: ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant
abilities.description_zh: 选择残焰，灰烬之灵将向其冲去。
abilities.description_en: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.

abilities.name: ember_spirit_immolation
abilities.description_zh: 灰烬之灵持续燃烧，时刻对周围所有敌人造成每秒伤害。
abilities.description_en: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
notes_zh: 破坏不会使阿哈利姆魔晶升级的残焰继承的献祭心失效。
notes_en: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.

shard_loc.en: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.
shard_loc.zh: 使残焰获得献祭心，并且每秒伤害和作用范围提升。

abilities.name: ember_spirit_fire_remnant
abilities.description_zh: 可以放出一个残焰，向目标地点冲去，速度为灰烬之灵移动速度的%speed_multiplier%%%。使用“激活残焰”技能后，灰烬之灵向所有残焰像冲去，将其摧毁并造成范围伤害，并移动至最近的残焰像。灰烬之灵最后会到达离目标地点最近的残焰像。
abilities.description_en: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
notes_zh: 学习后马上拥有3个残焰（上限数量）。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。

shard_loc.en: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
shard_loc.zh: 灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。
